fields.Name: More Cheese Content (Pinecone)
fields.Description: Knowledge Hub vector index for the International Cheese Federation public content (blog, reports, releases) and the internal vault. Pinecone serverless index 'morecheese-content', 3072 dimensions, cosine, embedded with Gemini Embedding 2.

fields.Name: More Cheese Duplicates (Pinecone)
fields.Description: Duplicate-detection vectors for the More Cheese People, Organizations and Products entity documents. Pinecone serverless index 'morecheese-duplicates', 3072 dimensions, cosine, embedded with Gemini Embedding 2. Each vector carries its EntityDocumentID, so the three documents share the index.
